title: Characteristic polynomial of a direct sum of endomorphisms of finite free modules
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring, $N_1,N_2$ free $B$-modules of finite ranks $n_1,n_2$, and $\psi_k:N_k\to N_k$ $B$-linear maps ($k=1,2$). Then $N_1\oplus N_2$ is a free $B$-module of rank $n_1+n_2$, and the characteristic polynomials (each $\det(T\cdot1-\psi)$, computed in any basis) satisfy $\det(T\cdot1-(\psi_1\oplus\psi_2))=\det(T\cdot1-\psi_1)\cdot\det(T\cdot1-\psi_2)$ in $B[T]$, where $(\psi_1\oplus\psi_2)(x_1,x_2)=(\psi_1x_1,\psi_2x_2)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XI (lemma-characterize-henselian-pair, line 2553), proof of (3)$\Rightarrow$(1), the free case of the identity CharPol$_A(T:B\to B)$ = CharPol$_A(T:eB\to eB)$ CharPol$_A(T:(1-e)B\to(1-e)B)$ ('Details omitted'): in the concatenated basis the matrix of $\psi_1\oplus\psi_2$ is block diagonal, and the determinant of a block-diagonal matrix is the product of the determinants of the blocks
